narrative: 一张脸在双眼保持对齐的情况下变成另一张脸。一具身体向着一个新的轮廓插值。
当“化为”应当以特征点对应关系的形式被看见，而不是通过剪辑或淡化来表现时使用它。如果人物本身保持不变、而房间应当改变，或者妆造和表演可以分阶段完成这个工作，这就用错了工具。
如果只有不透明度发生变化，你拍的是叠化。
how: 在两个端点上锁定姿势、视线和主光。设定特征点的对应关系（眼睛对眼睛，嘴巴对嘴巴，轮廓对轮廓）。
把前景和背景分离，避免形变把整个房间也一起拖拽变形。控制哪些特征先发生变化。
中间点应当是一个有意设计的过渡状态，而不是一团融化。提示词：a morph of the subject into another state: continuous transformation, identity as a dissolve you can watch。
对于视频，在整个镜头过程中渐变变形为另一种形态。
when: 用在一种形态必须在几秒钟的连续画面中变成另一种形态的那个瞬间。不要把它当作两个毫无共享特征点的不相关镜头之间一次花哨的剪辑。
vs: 作为剪辑手法的“匹配变形”（Morph）用这种形变作为两个镜头之间的接合点；而这里的渐变变形指的是几何插值本身。
变身（Transformation）可以是实体化妆、置景变化，或者围绕一具稳定身体的世界替换；渐变变形则是特征点的几何变化，而不是一个新房间。
examples_film: 《终结者2》（Terminator 2）在铬合金和血肉之间建立对应关系并进行插值；迈克尔·杰克逊的《黑与白》（Black or White）通过对齐的特征点让一张张脸依次转变。
《威洛：磨镜传奇》（Willow）在生物形态之间进行插值。这是语法，不是可以照搬的画面。
mistakes: 常见的错误近亲是叠化（Dissolve）。破绽是两张图像淡入淡出却没有共享的轮廓，或者一张脸毫无中间点设计地液化。
解决办法是匹配的姿势、匹配的光线，以及持续移动的特征点。

faq.q: 电影中的渐变变形是什么？
faq.a: 渐变变形通过对几何形态进行插值，把一个形状或图像连续地变换成另一个。这不是淡化，轮廓会从一种形态持续移动到下一种。

faq.q: 渐变变形 vs 叠化
faq.a: 叠化改变的是不透明度；渐变变形改变的是形状。交叉叠化在几帧之内可能看起来很像渐变变形，但它并不会连续地改变几何形态。

faq.q: 什么时候应该使用渐变变形？
faq.a: 当身份或形态必须在连续画面中变成另一种形态、并带有匹配的特征点时使用它。如果房间应当围绕一个稳定的人物发生变化，或者一次简单的淡化就足够了，就跳过它。

faq.q: 如何为AI图像或视频撰写渐变变形的提示词？
faq.a: 写下 "Morph of [Subject] into another state, continuous transformation"。明确两个端点、对齐的眼睛位置，以及哪些特征先发生变化。对于视频，让渐变变形贯穿整个镜头，而不是用剪辑完成。

narrative: A face becomes another face while the eyes stay aligned. A body interpolates toward a new contour.

Use it when becoming should be visible as a correspondence of landmarks, not as a cut or a fade. It is the wrong tool when the person stays the same and the room should change, or when makeup and performance can do the work in stages.
If only opacity changes, you shot a dissolve.
how: Lock pose, eyeline, and key on two endpoints. Set landmark matches (eyes to eyes, mouth to mouth, silhouette to silhouette).
Separate foreground from background so the warp does not drag the room. Control which features change first.
The midpoint should be an intentional in-between, not a melt. Prompt a morph of the subject into another state: continuous transformation, identity as a dissolve you can watch.
For video, morph into another form over the shot.
when: Use it for the beat when one form must become another in a few seconds of continuous view. Do not use it as a fancy cut between two unrelated shots with no shared landmarks.
vs: Morph as an edit uses the warp as the join between two shots. Morphing here is the geometric interpolation itself.
Transformation can be practical makeup, a set change, or a world swap around a stable body. Morphing is landmark geometry, not a new room.
examples_film: Terminator 2 interpolates chrome and flesh as correspondence. Michael Jackson's Black or White walks faces through aligned landmarks.
Willow interpolates between creature forms. Grammar, not frames to copy.
mistakes: The usual wrong cousin is a Dissolve. The tell is two images fading with no shared contour, or a liquefying face with no midpoint design.
The fix is matched pose, matched light, and landmarks that travel.

faq.a: Morphing transforms one shape or image continuously into another by interpolating geometry. It is not a fade. Contours travel from one form to the next.
A dissolve changes opacity. Morphing changes shape. A cross-dissolve can resemble a morph for a few frames, but it does not continuously transform geometry.
Use it when identity or form must become another form in continuous view, with matched landmarks. Skip it when the room should change around a stable person, or when a simple fade is enough.

faq.q: How do I prompt morphing for AI image or video?
faq.a: Write Morph of [Subject] into another state, continuous transformation. Specify both endpoints, aligned eyes, and which features change first. For video, morph over the shot, not a cut.
